calls.title: GrowthBook Webinar - Content Flow Sync
calls.summary: The call was a prep session for a GrowthBook webinar, where Ashley Stirrup (host) and Lyndsie Berens (coordinator) reviewed slides with Ben Fanning (customer/presenter from Fixer). They discussed Ben’s experimentation stack, including specific wins (e.g., paywall flip, gamified referrals) and automation via Slack and Cursor agents linked to GrowthBook, highlighting pain points around rigorous testing and learnings databases. Next steps: share slides with Leia (colleague) for her segment, hold a 15-minute rehearsal the next day, and launch the webinar on Thursday.

calls.title: GrowthBook Webinar - Content Flow Sync
calls.summary: The team focused on significant conversion improvements driven by various experiments, including an 8.16% increase in trial starts from paywall layout changes, a 210% boost in invite rates from gamified referrals, and a 20% lift in referrals from pre-filled email suggestions. Emphasizing the importance of learning from both successful and unsuccessful experiments, Ben Fanning highlighted the iterative testing approach. Leia's recent arrival has brought a focus on tightening experimentation rigor. The integration of internal tools ensures transparency and accessibility, streamlining the experimentation process. The team is preparing for a polished presentation, with clear assignments for Leia and Ben, while expressing confidence in their storytelling and coordination.
calls.keywords: experiment automation, feature flags, GrowthBook, Fixer, A/B testing, Slack integration
